answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each new account to a non-parallelizable admission puzzle signed by its key, then requiring two established attestors to lock a refundable bond for one full epoch. If a later clustering pass shows those accounts form a willow-like clone grove under one controller, the bonds are slashed and the cluster loses vote weight. A public lantern log records every attestation so peers can audit concentration, and a falcon watch on the endorsement graph caps any tightly knit neighborhood at a fixed share of governance power.
